summary: Audit of 'HR-pulse.pdf' (To make the project truly unique, add features that most HR platforms do not have.): Extracted 1321 words across 133 requirement statements. The document establishes functional scope but requires formal NFR definitions, API schema contracts, and security hardening.

risk_factors.title: Payment Processing & PCI-DSS Compliance Gap
risk_factors.description: Document mentions financial transactions or payments without defining PCI-DSS tokenization, webhook verification, or idempotent charge safety.
risk_factors.mitigation: Integrate certified payment gateway with client-side tokenization (e.g., Stripe Elements) and zero plain-text card data retention.

risk_factors.title: HIPAA / Protected Health Information (PHI) Exposure Risk
risk_factors.description: Healthcare data and doctor notes must comply with strict HIPAA encryption at rest (AES-256) and audit logging for patient privacy.
risk_factors.mitigation: Enforce field-level encryption, immutable audit trails, and strict multi-tenant boundary checks.

risk_factors.title: Missing Identity & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
risk_factors.description: No formal authentication mechanisms, session management, or role permissions (Admin, User, Auditor) are defined in the document.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement OAuth2 / JWT authentication middleware with explicit principle of least privilege enforcement.

risk_factors.title: Unspecified Data Protection & Boundary Controls
risk_factors.description: The 'HR-pulse.pdf' document lacks explicit encryption standards (TLS 1.3 in-transit, AES-256 at-rest) and rate-limiting rules.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement OWASP Top 10 defenses, rate limiting, and automated security scanning.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: Document outlines 133 core functional paths but does not define standard error handling (400/401/404/500).
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Publish OpenAPI 3.1 specification declaring exact error response bodies and validation codes.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Without security controls, system is vulnerable to unauthorized data access and injection attacks.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Specify token expiration, CORS policy, TLS 1.3 enforcement, and tenant data isolation.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Missing latency thresholds (P95 < 200ms), concurrent user targets, and database connection limits.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define target throughput (e.g. 500 RPS), 99.9% uptime SLA, and disaster recovery RTO/RPO.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Data models, foreign key relationships, and migration strategies are unaddressed.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Provide entity relationship diagrams (ERD) and JSON schema validation rules.
